summary: The CustomReportQueue system handles the management of custom report requests, including their creation, processing, and status management.
purpose: To facilitate the creation, management, and processing of custom report requests in an organizational setting.

workflows.name: Custom Report Request Management
steps: System binds data to drop-down lists and components on first load.
User can refresh view using cmdRefreshView.
System updates and re-binds data according to user selections.
Users with adequate permissions can perform actions (e.g., cancel, refuse, complete requests) on pending reports.
ViewState is used to manage sorting and state of dropdowns.

business_rules: Drop-down lists are aggregated from available agencies, departments, and users.
Reports can be in 'Pending' or 'Completed' mode.
Only users with System or Local Administrator privileges can view all options and manipulate report requests.
validations: User session must be valid for operations.
Drop down lists must have at least one item before additional entries or operations are conducted.
conditions: If ViewState['FirstLoad'] is 1, initial data binding is performed.
Buttons such as cmdCancelRequest and cmdRefuseRequest are hidden if the report status is not 'Pending'.
system_behavior: Auto-generate fields are customizable by moving declarations to the code-behind.
The system provides feedback prompts for cancellation and refusal actions using JavaScript.
